dataset.name: French primary prostate adenocarcinoma (ICGC PRAD-FR)
dataset.description: Independent French primary prostate-adenocarcinoma cohort with open ICGC Release 28 bulk RNA-seq and linked recurrence follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Primary prostate adenocarcinomas from the PRAD-FR project. The associated EGA study describes 15 French Caucasian and 10 African-Caribbean men enrolled to characterize genomic events associated with aggressive early-stage disease.
dataset.publication_citation: ICGC PRAD-FR and EGA EGAS00001002176 project record

metadata.redistribution_note: The open cohort is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, while direct matrix download remains disabled pending a dedicated ICGC redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: TRACE Explorer requires an exact recurrence interval or an explicit complete-remission censoring state with positive follow-up. Donors with a recorded recurrence type but no recurrence interval are excluded. One Ensembl/DESeq2 RNA-seq analysis linked to a primary 8140/3 adenocarcinoma is selected deterministically per donor.

expression.label: DESeq2-normalized expression
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Ambiguous symbols mapped from more than one Ensembl gene are removed before the matrix is written.
expression.scale_note: ICGC identifies the source normalization as DESeq2 1.14.1 and supplies transformed non-negative values on an approximately log2 count scale. TRACE Explorer preserves that supplied scale without applying a second logarithm, maps Ensembl identifiers with the pinned GRCh37 reference and restricts interpretation to within-cohort relative expression.

endpoints.label: Recurrence-free interval
endpoints.event_definition: First recorded local recurrence or distant recurrence/progression
